notes: Honghe government said Gejiu signed with Sugon in October 2019 and the cloud-computing big-data center was completed and operational in April 2020 in Datun New District. Phase I included 2000 sqm build area, a 300 sqm data hall, 54 cabinets, 116 servers, T3-standard construction, 12864 CPU cores, 17152 GB memory and 3500 TB storage.
